Original.Name: si-apply-templates-007
Original.CaseXml:
<ns0:test-case xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2012/10/xslt-test-catalog" name="si-apply-templates-007">
      <ns0:description>Test streaming apply-templates with a schema-aware match pattern (Saxon bug 3563).</ns0:description>
      <ns0:created by="Michael Kay" on="2017-12-08" />
      <ns0:environment>
         <ns0:schema file="../docs/books.xsd" />
         <ns0:source role="." streaming="true" file="../docs/books.xml" validation="strict" />
      </ns0:environment>
      <ns0:dependencies>
         <ns0:feature value="schema_aware" />
      </ns0:dependencies>
      <ns0:test>
         <ns0:stylesheet file="si-apply-templates-007.xsl" />
      </ns0:test>
      <ns0:result>
         <ns0:all-of>
            <ns0:assert>empty(//AUTHOR)</ns0:assert>
            <ns0:assert>exists(//TITLE)</ns0:assert>
         </ns0:all-of>
      </ns0:result>
   </ns0:test-case>
Original.EnvironmentXml:
<ns0:environment xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2012/10/xslt-test-catalog">
         <ns0:schema file="../docs/books.xsd" />
         <ns0:source role="." streaming="true" file="../docs/books.xml" validation="strict" />
      </ns0:environment>

Observed.name: si-apply-templates-007
Observed.detail: environment schema uses xs:assert/xs:alternative (XSD 1.1; engine supports XSD 1.0 only)

Original.Name: catalog-005

<ns0:test-case xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2012/10/xslt-test-catalog" name="catalog-005">
      <ns0:description>Test that all non-error stylesheets are valid against the schema for
         stylesheets</ns0:description>
      <ns0:keywords>catalog-self-test tests-stylesheet-schema-validity xsl:import-schema</ns0:keywords>
      <ns0:created by="Michael Kay" on="2013-11-28" />
      <ns0:modified by="Abel Braaksma" on="2019-03-10" change="Bug #30414: removed global schema-aware flag, local flag stays, this test requires schema-aware" />
      <ns0:modified by="Michael Kay" on="2021-06-14" change="Add XML 1.1 dependency" />
      <ns0:environment ref="catalog005" />
      <ns0:dependencies>
         <ns0:spec value="XSLT30+" />
         <ns0:feature value="schema_aware" />
         <ns0:feature value="XML_1.1" />
      </ns0:dependencies>
      <ns0:test>
         <ns0:stylesheet file="catalog-005.xsl" />
         <ns0:param name="supports_xml1.1" static="yes" select="true()" />
      </ns0:test>
      <ns0:result>
         
         <ns0:assert-xml><out/></ns0:assert-xml>
      </ns0:result>
   </ns0:test-case>

<ns0:environment xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2012/10/xslt-test-catalog" name="catalog005">

      <ns0:schema role="secondary" file="../../../admin/xml.xsd" xsd-version="1.1" />
      <ns0:schema role="secondary" file="XMLSchema.xsd" xsd-version="1.1" />
      <ns0:schema role="source-reference" file="schema-for-xslt30.xsd" xsd-version="1.1" />
